title: Callback
description: projectkit contract v1.3.0 — the RESULT of executing a dispatched Concern, returned by a dispatch adapter (webhook POST) or fetched by the testbed (poll). Cross-language mirror of src/dispatch.ts (Callback). Keyed by concern_ref back to the originating Concern. This is the return leg that makes dispatch a two-way seam, so mesh is ONE swappable dispatch adapter rather than the owner of dispatch/poll routes. A consumer tolerates 1.3.0.
